hero.subtitle: A Telegram bot books, reminds, and brings patients back. The admin panel shows every doctor's schedule, workload, and analytics on one screen. Live in a single day.

footer.tagline: Automated patient booking for dental clinics via a Telegram bot

problemSolution.title: Clinics lose patients over small things
problemSolution.description: A booking that landed in the wrong slot, a callback nobody made, a reminder nobody sent. None of that is a staff mistake — it's a missing system.
before: Front desk spends the whole day on the phone, writing bookings into a notebook or Excel
Bookings are scattered across WhatsApp, Viber, and Instagram
Patients forget their appointment — the open slot just goes to waste
The owner can't see workload or where patients actually come from
after: Patients book themselves in 30 seconds, any time of day
Every channel feeds one schedule — no double-booking
Reminders go out automatically a day and an hour before
Analytics on doctors, services, and booking sources — in real time

howItWorks.title: Three minutes for the patient — zero minutes for staff

steps.title: Patient opens the bot
steps.text: A button on the site, Instagram, or a QR code in the clinic. The bot greets them and shows open slots.

steps.title: Picks a time and a doctor
steps.text: Real open slots straight from the schedule. A booked slot disappears instantly — in the bot and in the panel.

steps.title: The clinic sees the booking
steps.text: The booking lands in the admin panel, and the bot sends reminders and collects a review after the visit on its own.

adminShowcase.title: The whole clinic in one screen
adminShowcase.description: Bookings from the bot and bookings staff enter by hand live on the same schedule.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: One business day. We build the bot, import your doctors' schedules and services, and walk your team through the panel. All we need from you is a service list and working hours.

items.question: Does the clinic need a technical specialist?
items.answer: No. We handle setup — after that, everything is managed from the admin panel: hours, services, prices, reminder texts.

items.question: What happens to bookings staff enter manually?
items.answer: They live on the same schedule as bot bookings. A booked slot disappears from the bot instantly, so double-booking never happens.

items.question: Can we work in channels other than Telegram?
items.answer: Yes. The Clinic and Network plans add Viber, WhatsApp, and a web widget for the clinic's site. Every channel feeds the same schedule.

items.question: Where is patient data stored?
items.answer: On servers in the EU, with access restricted by staff role. Data can be exported or deleted on request.
